excerpt.en: No prize at the poster competition, plenty learned at the workshop, and some difficult driving in Philadelphia.
excerpt.zh: 海报比赛没有拿到奖，workshop 学到了很多。在费城开车对我来说有点难。

en: I took part in the INFORMS poster competition. I felt the presentation went pretty well, though I didn’t win a prize.
I went to the CRSE Workshop in Philadelphia and learned a lot. Everyone was very kind. Driving in Philadelphia was pretty difficult for me.
zh: 参加了 INFORMS 的海报比赛，讲得还不错，不过没有拿到奖。
去了费城的 CRSE Workshop，学到了很多，大家都很亲切。对我来说，在费城开车确实有点难。
